provenance.instrument: Lower Allen Township Code Chapter 220 Zoning (Ord. No. 2009-2, 7-13-2009, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2025-01-27 (breadcrumb). New Laws on 2026-11-14: nine ordinances (2025-2026), none amending Chapter 220. The R-1 use list was last amended 1-27-2025 by Ord. No. 2025-01.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2025-01-27'. The New Laws listed do not amend Chapter 220.
checks: An accessory dwelling is a permitted use in R-1, R-2 and MUN, and in the TND and NR overlays (220-11D, 220-19D, 220-28G, 220-124, 220-139K). A code search found it in no other district list. R-3 allows conversion apartments and two-family dwellings instead (220-37)
The accessory dwelling is created in a single-family detached dwelling that the applicant owns and lives in. The house or the unit must be the owner's principal residence (220-149, 220-149C)
Only one accessory dwelling per house. It must have its own living, sleeping, cooking and bathroom areas (220-149A, B)
Size: at most 30% of the building's total floor area and at least 360 sq ft of habitable floor area (220-149G, H)

Additions and alterations to create the unit are limited to 10% of the floor area existing at the time of the permit application, and no application is approved if the habitable floor area was increased in the last three years (220-149F, I)
The house keeps the look of a single-family detached dwelling. New entrances go on the sides or rear (220-149D)
The Lower Allen Township Authority rules on connection and fees for an additional dwelling unit apply (220-149E)
In the TND and NR overlays at most 5% of the residential uses may be accessory dwelling units, and not more than 10% on a street in any block (220-127, 220-142, search snippets)

Density: R-1 allows 4 dwelling units per gross acre with public water and sewer (1 per acre with on-lot systems), R-2 1 per gross acre and MUN 10 per gross acre. Whether the accessory dwelling counts is not settled (220-13, 220-21, 220-30)
Parking: 2 spaces per dwelling unit for single-family dwellings. Apartments are counted by bedrooms (220-239, search snippet)
Accessory structures may not stand in a front yard setback and must be at least 5 ft from side and rear lot lines. Accessory buildings are capped at 25 ft (220-150A, B(1), 220-12B)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Lower Allen Township (latwp.org). Read on eCode360 (LO1571) in a browser, one print view at a time, on 2026-11-14. Use lists read for R-1, R-2, MUN and R-3. The TND and NR overlay sections and 220-239 were seen as search snippets only. The commercial and industrial lists allow only watchman or caretaker dwellings (I-1, I-2, I-3, search snippets).

term.note: 'An accessory dwelling may be created in a single-family detached dwelling that is owned and occupied by the permit applicant.'

status.note: A permitted use in R-1, R-2 and MUN under the standards of 220-149.

scope_districts.note: TND and NR are overlays, read from search snippets.

status_outside.note: Other district lists do not name the accessory dwelling. The unlisted-use special exception (220-181) reaches only uses not permitted in any district, so it does not apply.

path.note: Listed among 'the permitted uses', in accordance with 220-149.

fallback_path.note: A unit that does not meet 220-149 needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Conversion apartment
value.conditions: A building that existed on 7-13-2009 converted to a dwelling for more than one family. It must meet the district rules, with no outside sign of change except as codes require. Three or more units need a land development plan.

requires.condition: The building existed at the effective date of the chapter

value.name: Conversion apartment
value.conditions: Same standards as R-3, by special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board.

requires.condition: The building existed at the effective date of the chapter

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: Two-family attached and side-by-side dwellings are permitted uses.
value.note: Read as a path for converting a house into two units. The R-3 lot rules were not read.

existing_structure_only.note: Created in an existing house, which may be enlarged by at most 10% of its existing floor area. The house_exists gate carries the existing-house rule.

value.condition: The house is owned and occupied by the permit applicant, and the house or the unit is the owner's principal residence.
Created in an existing single-family detached dwelling.
Additions and alterations to create the unit are limited to 10% of the floor area existing at the time of application. No approval if the habitable floor area was increased within three years.
The building keeps the look of a single-family detached dwelling. New entrances on the sides or rear.
Township Authority rules on connection of and fees for an additional dwelling unit apply.
In the TND and NR overlays at most 5% of residential uses may be accessory dwelling units, and not more than 10% on a street in any block.

types_allowed.note: Inside the house, or with an addition of at most 10% of the existing floor area.

types_not_addressed.note: The unit is created in the single-family detached dwelling. A unit in a separate building is not named.

max_sqft.note: No square-foot cap. Share cap of 30%.

max_share_of_house.note: 'The accessory dwelling shall not be greater than 30% of the building's total floor area.'

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: Accessory buildings, which may not hold the unit.

max_adus.note: 'Only one accessory dwelling may be created within a single-family detached dwelling unit.'

spaces_required.note: Single-family dwellings: '2 per dwelling unit'. Apartments are counted by bedrooms.

reading.value: Two spaces per dwelling unit, so four for the house and the unit, if the unit is counted like a single-family dwelling unit. Counted as an apartment it needs 1 to 3 spaces by bedrooms.

new_connection_required.note: Township Authority rules on connection and fees for an additional dwelling unit apply.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public water and public sewer. No minimum with on-lot systems (density 1 unit per gross acre).

max_building_coverage.note: Impervious coverage. No separate building coverage is set.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Four dwelling units per gross acre with public water and sewer. One per acre with on-lot systems. Whether the accessory dwelling counts is not settled.

max_building_coverage.note: Impervious coverage. No separate building coverage is set.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'There shall be no minimum lot area.' Width 100 ft at the building line.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: One dwelling unit per gross acre. Whether the accessory dwelling counts is not settled.

max_building_coverage.note: Impervious coverage. No separate building coverage is set.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'There shall be no minimum lot area.' Width 50 ft.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Ten units per gross acre. Whether the accessory dwelling counts is not settled.
